title: Real form of the one-point flip
statement: For every integer $k\ge 0$, the real-valued function obtained from the one-point-flipped full parity function by viewing its signs as real numbers equals the real-valued full parity function minus $2$ at the all-one input, and equals the real-valued full parity function at every other input.
